description: generateLevel / solveGreedy / randomWinRate / buildLevel on cases the built-in levels do not reach: hand-set options, large seeds, the fallback and unverified paths. tried = every tray buildLevel generates, in order (phase candidate: seed + 7919k; fallback: seed + k, shuffle * (1 - k/8); unverified: shuffle 0); result = what buildLevel returns, result.tried = its index in tried; greedy = [solved, ticks, taps]; games[g] = randomWinRate(level, 1, seed + 101g).
